{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge merino jumper, slim fit, crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy #6D2433, merino wool
Midi skirt, A-line, falling just below the knee, charcoal #3A3D42, wool crepe
Matte opaque tights, charcoal-black #2B2B2E, soft microfibre
Long coat, straight cut, single-breasted, mid-calf, camel #B08D63, wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather
Small crossbody bag, structured, black #1C1C1E, calfskin leather
Drop earrings, slim and understated, warm gold #C9A24D, polished metal
Scarf, light and generous, burgundy and camel print (#6D2433 and #B08D63), silk twill

This outfit sits right in the neat band: a refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots is polished without being stiff. The deep burgundy reads rich under theatre lighting, and the charcoal skirt and black boots keep the whole look calm and grounded. The camel coat carries you through a cool autumn evening and comes off easily in the cloakroom. The heel is low enough to stay comfortable through a 19:00 performance and the interval, and the gold earrings and silk scarf add a touch of occasion."}
